title: Record size budget and where evidence goes
goal: Records stay short; older evidence moves to a dated archive with a link
acceptance: check:backlog warns when a record passes its budget (default about 1.5k tokens)
BACKLOG-RULES says evidence older than the last reconciliation moves to the archive with a link back
privacy: Tool and rule text only; fixtures invented.
escalation: Quieting an output must never hide a failure: anything that fails is printed in full

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14 at agent speed. Not a measurement.
